mapper.select: SELECT * FROM focus_routines WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT * FROM focus_routines WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM focus_sessions WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM focus_sessions WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND phase <> 'ENDED' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM focus_sessions WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE focus_routines SET enabled=#{enabled},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo_items(id,user_id,project_id,title,notes,priority,routine_id,occurrence_date,default_focus_duration_minutes) VALUES (#{id},#{userId},#{projectId},#{title},'','MEDIUM',#{routineId},#{date},#{duration}) ON CONFLICT (user_id,routine_id,occurrence_date) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO focus_sessions(id,user_id,request_id,task_id,project_id,title,target_ms,interval_ms,zone_id, phase,started_at,anchor_at,next_break_at_ms) VALUES (#{id},#{userId},#{requestId},#{taskId},#{projectId},#{title},#{targetMs},#{intervalMs},#{zoneId}, 'RUNNING',#{now},#{now},#{intervalMs}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE focus_sessions SET phase=#{session.phase},version=version+1,anchor_at=#{session.anchorAt}, ended_at=#{session.endedAt},focus_ms=#{session.focusMs},break_ms=#{session.breakMs}, pause_ms=#{session.pauseMs}, resume_phase=#{session.resumePhase},break_remaining_ms=#{session.breakRemainingMs}, next_break_at_ms=#{session.nextBreakAtMs},reminders_dismissed=#{session.remindersDismissed}, reminder_ordinal=#{session.reminderOrdinal},controller_id=#{session.controllerId}, controller_generation=#{session.controllerGeneration},controller_expires_at=#{session.controllerExpiresAt}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{session.id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{session.version}
mapper.select: SELECT start_at,end_at, CASE WHEN kind='FOCUS' THEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_at-start_at)*1000)::bigint ELSE 0 END focus_ms, CASE WHEN kind='BREAK' THEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_at-start_at)*1000)::bigint ELSE 0 END break_ms FROM focus_intervals WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND confirmed AND kind IN ('FOCUS','BREAK') ORDER BY start_at,ordinal
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_records(id,user_id,project_id,todo_id,focus_session_id,content,source,is_active, completion_result,business_date,focus_ms,break_ms,segment_start,segment_end,occurred_at) VALUES (#{id},#{userId},#{projectId},#{taskId},#{sessionId},#{content},'FOCUS_SESSION',TRUE,'', #{date},#{focusMs},#{breakMs},#{start},#{end},#{start}) ON CONFLICT (user_id,focus_session_id,business_date) WHERE source='FOCUS_SESSION' DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE focus_sessions SET progress=#{progress},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{version} AND phase='ENDED'
UPDATE work_records SET progress=#{progress},updated_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND focus_session_id=#{id} AND source='FOCUS_SESSION'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(sum(focus_ms),0) focus_ms,COALESCE(sum(break_ms),0) break_ms, count(DISTINCT focus_session_id) session_count FROM work_records WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source='FOCUS_SESSION' AND business_date=#{date} AND is_active
